messages:
Maria: Heads up — weekly KPI dashboard showing leads from last 7 days looks off after yesterday's deploy. Link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpis :eyes:
Tom: Which metric? Total MQLs or inbound web leads?
Maria: Inbound web leads (form submits). Dashboard shows 1,120 but GA shows ~780. Noticed a spike at 10:05am yesterday.
Ben (Analytics): I pulled the raw events. There's a batch of 360 events with utm_campaign="webinar_draft" coming from /lp/webinar-2026?utm_campaign=webinar-draft (note the dash vs underscore). Possible UTM mismatch.
Priya: That landing page was updated yesterday, sorry — marketing dev used `webinar-draft` in the template but campaign = webinar_draft in our mapping. :grimacing: 
Tom: Ok that's the cause. We can normalize at ETL but that will take time. Could we fix the template and reprocess? Or apply fix in dashboard query?
Ben (Analytics): Quick fix in query is fastest. Replace variants and aggregate. SQL snippet:
```
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(utm_campaign,'[-_]','_'),'') , 'direct') as campaign_norm,
  count(*) as leads
FROM events
WHERE event_type='form_submit' AND event_time > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1;
```
Priya: I'll patch the template now and open a PR.
Alexa: For attribution debate — do we continue reporting last-touch on the dashboard? The webinar traffic will look better under time-decay model.
Erin (Growth): For weekly ops I prefer last-touch (fast, explainable). For growth experiments we should add a DDA toggle. Could the dashboard support both? :gear: 
Ben (Analytics): Yes — add a parameter `attribution_model` with values `last_touch|time_decay|first_touch`. I can add two columns and a switch.
Maria: Love that. Action items: 1) Priya fixes template PR (in progress), 2) Ben adds normalization + attribution switch, 3) Tom to rerun exports and confirm numbers by EOD. Meeting to review tomorrow 10:30am.
Tom: I'll rerun exports and post results here.
stats-bot: Weekly KPI snapshot posted: Leads: 780 (7d), MQL conv: 4.5%, ARR impact est: $47k. <auto>
Ben (Analytics): Posted query + visualization changes to the dashboard. Please refresh and confirm.
Priya: PR merged. Patch note: fixed utm_campaign generation on webinar lp. :tada: 
Maria: Numbers look aligned now — dashboard and GA within 3%. Thanks everyone! :clap: 
Alexa: Let's include a short blurb for weekly update explaining the attribution toggle and the UTM fix.
Maria: Good call. I'll draft the note and share for review.
